messages:
alex: quick FYI — ran the nightly link-scan and found 2x 404s in the private-deploy runbook. who owns /runbooks/private-deploy.md? small patch needed.
priya: I own the runbook but I'm OOO tomorrow. can someone open a tiny PR? I can merge on Friday.
sam: @priya I can pick this up now. which exact paths are 404ing?
alex: scanner output (copied):
```
404 /runbooks/private-deploy.md#k8s-config
404 /assets/arch-priv.png
```
lex: looks like the diagram asset is gone from the CDN and the anchor might be a frontmatter id change. @sam do you have upload perms to the S3 bucket? if not i can rehost in the docs repo.
sam: i don't have AWS write perms. @ops-bot can you create a rehost ticket or grant short-term creds?
ops-bot: Created ticket INF-1421 to rehost assets and investigate CDN TTL. Assigned to eng-infra. ETA ~48h.
priya: if infra can't move that quickly, easiest temporary fix: point the image to repo/images/arch-priv.png and add a comment in the runbook saying it's a temp rehost until INF-1421 is done. small PR, no infra change.
sam: okay I'll open a PR with the temp path + keep the original anchor intact (just add an HTML comment where i moved the section). @priya can you give final review when you're back?
alex: also pinging @docs team to consider adding CODEOWNERS for /runbooks/* so this doesn't slip.
lex: tiny nit — if you change frontmatter IDs, anchors break. prefer updating frontmatter aliases instead of moving headings.
sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821 — changes: update image path to repo/images/arch-priv.png, add comment about INF-1421, no content changes. reviewers: priya, lex.
priya: glanced remotely — LGTM. will give formal review on Friday and merge if infra is still pending.
alex: thanks all :thumbsup: i'll follow up with infra on INF-1421 and post updates here.
